Components are added here in the same PR that creates them (Phase 2+); nodeId values are looked up in Figma dev mode or via MCP at build time.

Atom/Tag.notes: Figma 'Color' axis → semantic CVA variant: Grey→neutral, Red→urgent, Yellow→medium, Blue→mid, Green→low (matches card priority enum)

Checkbox.notes: Checked=No/Yes prop; fetched node has no 'delete' state — needs triage before a future ticket adds it (#16)

Icon/*.notes: single wrapper around lucide-react@1.25.0+ (upgraded 2026-07-20 for the Broccoli icon, added upstream between v1.14–1.15). Figma layer names are kept in sync with lucide export names (renamed 2026-07-20, refined again same day: Clock→Alarm-clock-check, Cake→Cake-slice, List→Scroll, Folder→Folder-closed, Columns→Columns-3, Cross→X, Calandar typo fixed to Calendar) so IconName is a direct PascalCase lookup — every entry verified against rendered SVG structure, not name alone (caught 2 real bugs this way: Columns was previously mismapped to Columns2, a 2-column/1-divider icon, when Figma's vector has 2 dividers = 3 columns; Cross was previously mapped by literal name to lucide's medical-cross glyph instead of X). PARTIALLY RESOLVED: Figma layers 'Panel-right-open'/'Panel-right-close' (nodes 3687:4453 / 3629:126) had their open/close labels swapped relative to chevron direction — fixed 2026-07-20 by the user, now verified consistent (the '...close' node's chevron points left = PanelLeftClose shape; the '...open' node's chevron points right = PanelLeftOpen shape). STILL UNRESOLVED: both nodes' divider is at x=9 (left-third), i.e. PanelLeft* geometry — lucide's actual PanelRightOpen/PanelRightClose have the divider at x=15. Code renders PanelLeftClose/PanelLeftOpen (shape-verified) under IconName values PanelRightClose/PanelRightOpen (Figma-name-matched) — needs a decision: move the Figma vector's divider to x=15 if this is truly a right-side panel, or rename the Figma layers to 'Panel-left-*' if the shape is correct as-is.
